The words of a param, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== param.default
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: int
        default: 3
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who:
    type: int
    default: 3

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: int
        default: many
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 5:18
the default for `who` is not int

=== param.description
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        description:   Who it is for.
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who:
    type: string
    description: Who it is for.

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        description: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 5:22
`description` must be text, found a list

=== param.enum
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        enum: [a, b]
        default: a
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who:
    type: string
    enum: [a, b]
    default: a

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        enum: 3
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 5:15
`enum` must be a list

=== param.required
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        required: true
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who:
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
        required: maybe
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 5:19
`required` must be true or false

=== param.type
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: string
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who:
    type: string

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params:
    who:
        type: thing
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 4:15
unknown type `thing`; expected one of: string, int, number, bool, list, object, duration, any
